Personal collection of (mostly free) fonts

Everyone has a favorite font, right? RIGHT!?

This is just a personal and opinionated collection of fonts that stuck with me and started as an excuse to show off the font_specimen_generator.py (I asked Claude to cobble together). I switche to a HTML preview instead.

This list is also influenced by Teuderun.

List of Font. In no specific order.

Atkinson Hyperlegible Next

Aa Rr Ee

Aa Rr Ee

Braille

0123456789

Nomen et omen. Very readable. I like it and its growing on me. Developed by the Braille Institute of America this font is intended to be easily readable for readers who are partially blind, with all characters being as different from each other as possible.

python font_specimen_generator.py

Asked Claude to cobble together a python script to generate the font specimen preview inspired by the ones on Wikipedia

Currently supports 3 different themes: cream, dark, white

Examples:

python font_specimen_generator.py --input ./fonts --output ./previews python font_specimen_generator.py --input ./fonts --output ./previews --theme white python font_specimen_generator.py --input ./fonts --output ./previews --width 1400 --theme cream python font_specimen_generator.py --input ./fonts --output ./previews --overwrite

made with ❤️ and font from a lot of people.
